note: Hand-written beginner notes for the items a new player meets first. 'does' says what the item is and does; 'bestFor' says when to use it or what to watch out for. They replace the imported description and tip for that item and its /DST variant. Add an entry here to cover another item.

notes.name: Axe
notes.does: Chops down trees to get Logs. It is the first tool most players make.
notes.bestFor: Make it on day 1. You need Logs for every fire, so wood comes before anything else.

notes.name: Pickaxe
notes.does: Mines boulders for Rocks, Flint, Nitre and Gold.
notes.bestFor: Make it right after the Axe. Mine boulders with yellow veins first: they drop the Gold you need for a Science Machine.

notes.name: Shovel
notes.does: Digs up berry bushes, grass tufts and saplings so you can replant them. It also digs up tree stumps and graves.
notes.bestFor: Best once you have picked a camp: move plants next to it so you stop walking for basic supplies.

notes.name: Hammer
notes.does: Breaks down structures and gives back about half of their materials.
notes.bestFor: Use it when you built something in the wrong place, or to take apart things you find in the world.

notes.name: Pitchfork
notes.does: Digs up the ground tile you are standing on as a Turf item.
notes.bestFor: Not needed early. It matters later, when you want to change the ground around your base.

notes.name: Razor
notes.does: Shaves a sleeping Beefalo for Beefalo Wool. It also shaves a beard.
notes.bestFor: Use it at night while Beefalo sleep, to get wool for winter clothing without a fight.

notes.name: Torch
notes.does: A light you carry in your hand. It burns out after a short time.
notes.bestFor: Your emergency light when night catches you away from a fire. Keep one ready, but do not rely on it all night.

notes.name: Campfire
notes.does: A temporary fire that gives light and warmth and lets you cook. It burns out and disappears.
notes.bestFor: Best for your first nights and when you are away from camp. Keep it away from trees and grass, because fire spreads.

notes.name: Miner Hat
notes.does: A hat with a light, so both hands stay free.
notes.bestFor: Best for working or fighting at night and for exploring caves.

notes.name: Lantern
notes.does: A bright light you can carry or put on the ground, and refill when it runs low.
notes.bestFor: A long-term replacement for the Torch once you can find Light Bulbs in caves.

notes.name: Backpack
notes.does: Adds 8 extra inventory slots while you wear it.
notes.bestFor: Make it as soon as you have a Science Machine. It uses the body slot, so you cannot wear it with body armour.

notes.name: Trap
notes.does: Catches small creatures such as rabbits, spiders and frogs.
notes.bestFor: Place it right on top of a rabbit hole and come back later. An easy, safe source of meat.

notes.name: Bird Trap
notes.does: Catches birds that land on it.
notes.bestFor: Put Seeds in it as bait to catch birds faster. Birds give meat and feathers.

notes.name: Thermal Stone
notes.does: A stone that stores heat. Leave it by a fire, then carry it to stay warm.
notes.bestFor: The key item for your first winter. Reheat it whenever its colour fades.

notes.name: Healing Salve
notes.does: Restores some health when used.
notes.bestFor: Keep a few in your inventory. Health does not come back on its own.

notes.name: Honey Poultice
notes.does: Restores more health than a Healing Salve.
notes.bestFor: Worth making once you have Bee Boxes and a steady supply of Honey.

notes.name: Fishing Rod
notes.does: Lets you fish at ponds.
notes.bestFor: A calm, safe food source if a pond is near your camp.

notes.name: Bug Net
notes.does: Catches bees, butterflies and fireflies.
notes.bestFor: You need it to catch the bees for your own Bee Boxes.

notes.name: Spear
notes.does: A basic, reliable weapon.
notes.bestFor: Your first real weapon. Make it before you fight anything stronger than a single spider.

notes.name: Log Suit
notes.does: Body armour that absorbs most of the damage you take.
notes.bestFor: Cheap and strong. Put it on before any fight, and when you hear hounds coming.

notes.name: Grass Suit
notes.does: Weak body armour made only from grass and twigs.
notes.bestFor: Only when you have nothing better. A Log Suit protects much more for a small extra cost.

notes.name: Football Helmet
notes.does: Head armour that absorbs most of the damage you take.
notes.bestFor: Wear it together with a Log Suit. It needs Pig Skin, so it usually comes a bit later.

notes.name: Ham Bat
notes.does: A strong weapon made from meat. It gets weaker as it spoils.
notes.bestFor: Great damage for its cost. Make it shortly before the fights you plan to use it in.

notes.name: Boomerang
notes.does: A weapon you throw. It comes back, and you must catch it.
notes.bestFor: Good for hunting birds and rabbits. Catch it as it returns, or it hits you.

notes.name: Science Machine
notes.does: Unlocks a first set of new recipes while you stand next to it.
notes.bestFor: Build it on day 2 or 3. Once you have made an item near it, you can craft that item anywhere.

notes.name: Alchemy Engine
notes.does: Unlocks the second tier of recipes, including better armour and winter gear.
notes.bestFor: Build it once your camp is set up. It replaces the Science Machine.

notes.name: Chest
notes.does: Stores 9 stacks of items at your camp.
notes.bestFor: Build several early. A free inventory means fewer trips back to camp.

notes.name: Drying Rack
notes.does: Turns raw meat into dried meat that lasts a very long time.
notes.bestFor: Best way to stock food before winter. Dried meat also restores health and sanity.

notes.name: Ice Box
notes.does: Storage that makes food spoil much more slowly.
notes.bestFor: Worth the effort once you collect more food than you eat in a few days.

notes.name: Bee Box
notes.does: A home for bees that slowly fills with Honey.
notes.bestFor: A steady, safe food source. Harvest carefully: the bees attack unless you wear protection.

notes.name: Tent
notes.does: Lets you sleep through the night. Sleeping restores health and sanity but costs hunger.
notes.bestFor: Use it when your sanity is low. It wears out after a few uses.

notes.name: Lightning Rod
notes.does: Draws lightning strikes to itself.
notes.bestFor: Build one at your camp before spring, so lightning does not set your base on fire.

notes.name: Rope
notes.does: A refined material made from Cut Grass.
notes.bestFor: Needed for the Spear, the Log Suit and many other items. Make a few as soon as you have a Science Machine.

notes.name: Boards
notes.does: A refined material made from Logs.
notes.bestFor: Needed for Chests and most buildings. Turn spare Logs into Boards whenever you are at camp.

notes.name: Papyrus
notes.does: A refined material made from Cut Reeds.
notes.bestFor: Needed for the Honey Poultice and a few later items. Not urgent in your first days.

notes.name: Twigs
notes.does: A basic material picked from saplings. It grows back after a few days.
notes.bestFor: Used in almost every early tool. Pick every sapling you walk past.

notes.name: Cut Grass
notes.does: A basic material picked from grass tufts. It grows back after a few days.
notes.bestFor: Needed for Rope, Traps, Campfires and Torches. Always carry a stack.

notes.name: Flint
notes.does: A sharp stone found on the ground and inside boulders.
notes.bestFor: Needed for every basic tool. Pick it up whenever you see it.

notes.name: Rocks
notes.does: A basic material you get by mining boulders with a Pickaxe.
notes.bestFor: Needed for the Science Machine and for permanent fires. Keep about 20.

notes.name: Log
notes.does: Wood from chopped trees. It is both a building material and fuel.
notes.bestFor: Your main fuel for fires, and the source of Boards. Never go to bed without a stack.

notes.name: Gold Nugget
notes.does: A valuable material from boulders with yellow veins.
notes.bestFor: You need one for a Science Machine, so look for it on day 1 or 2.

notes.name: Charcoal
notes.does: What is left when a tree burns. Chop the burnt tree to collect it.
notes.bestFor: Needed for the Drying Rack and the Crock Pot. Burn a few trees on purpose, away from your camp.

notes.name: Silk
notes.does: A material dropped by spiders and their nests.
notes.bestFor: Needed for the Tent, the Bug Net, the Fishing Rod and warm clothing.

notes.name: Pig Skin
notes.does: A material from pigs. You also get it by hammering pig houses.
notes.bestFor: Needed for the Football Helmet, the Ham Bat and the Umbrella.

notes.name: Nightmare Fuel
notes.does: A dark material dropped by shadow creatures.
notes.bestFor: Only needed for magic items. You can ignore it in your first weeks.

notes.name: Berries
notes.does: Food picked from berry bushes. The bushes regrow after a few days.
notes.bestFor: Easy early food. Cook them over a fire so they fill you up a little more.

notes.name: Carrot
notes.does: Food pulled out of the ground.
notes.bestFor: Good early food, raw or cooked. It can also be used to lure rabbits.

notes.name: Seeds
notes.does: Dropped by birds. They can be eaten, planted or used as bait.
notes.bestFor: Cook them for a small snack, or use them as bait in a Bird Trap.

notes.name: Petals
notes.does: Picked from flowers. Picking a flower restores a little sanity.
notes.bestFor: Collect 12 to make a Garland, the cheapest way to keep your sanity up.

notes.name: Nitre
notes.does: A mineral found in some boulders.
notes.bestFor: Not needed early. Keep what you find for later recipes.

notes.name: Beefalo Wool
notes.does: Wool from Beefalo. Shave them with a Razor while they sleep.
notes.bestFor: Needed for the warm hats that get you through winter.

notes.name: Cut Reeds
notes.does: Picked from reeds in the swamp.
notes.bestFor: Needed for Papyrus. The swamp is dangerous, so grab them quickly and leave.

notes.name: Manure
notes.does: Dropped by Beefalo and by pigs you feed.
notes.bestFor: Makes plants grow faster, and wakes up berry bushes you have moved. It also burns as fuel.

notes.name: Pine Cone
notes.does: The seed of an evergreen tree. Plant it to grow a new tree.
notes.bestFor: Plant a small forest near your camp for a steady wood supply. It also burns as fuel.

notes.name: Spider Gland
notes.does: Dropped by spiders. Using it restores a little health.
notes.bestFor: Use it directly in an emergency, or turn it into a Healing Salve, which heals more.

notes.name: Stinger
notes.does: Dropped by bees.
notes.bestFor: Not needed early. It is used for darts and traps later on.

notes.name: Honey
notes.does: Sweet food from beehives and Bee Boxes. It takes a very long time to spoil.
notes.bestFor: Good emergency food to carry, and a useful ingredient in cooking.

notes.name: Gears
notes.does: Mechanical parts dropped by clockwork monsters.
notes.bestFor: Needed for the Ice Box. The monsters that drop them are dangerous, so wait until you have armour.

notes.name: Meat
notes.does: Raw meat from large animals.
notes.bestFor: Cook it or dry it before eating. Pigs become your followers if you give them meat.

notes.name: Morsel
notes.does: A small piece of meat from rabbits and birds.
notes.bestFor: Cook it for a quick meal. Easy to get from Traps.

notes.name: Monster Meat
notes.does: Meat from spiders and hounds. Eating it hurts you.
notes.bestFor: Do not eat it raw. Feed it to pigs, or use a single piece as filler in cooked meals.

notes.name: Garland
notes.does: A flower crown that slowly restores sanity while you wear it.
notes.bestFor: The cheapest fix for low sanity: it only needs 12 Petals and no Science Machine.

notes.name: Straw Hat
notes.does: A simple hat that gives a little protection from rain and heat.
notes.bestFor: Mostly useful as an ingredient for better hats.

notes.name: Top Hat
notes.does: A hat that restores sanity while you wear it.
notes.bestFor: A longer-lasting replacement for the Garland once you have Silk.

notes.name: Winter Hat
notes.does: A warm hat that slows down freezing.
notes.bestFor: Make it before winter. Wear it with a Thermal Stone to travel safely in the cold.

notes.name: Beefalo Hat
notes.does: A very warm hat. Beefalo also leave you alone while you wear it.
notes.bestFor: The warmest early hat. It needs a Beefalo Horn, which means killing a Beefalo.

notes.name: Rabbit Earmuffs
notes.does: Earmuffs that give a little warmth.
notes.bestFor: A cheap stopgap for early winter if you have no Beefalo Wool yet.

notes.name: Umbrella
notes.does: Keeps you dry in the rain.
notes.bestFor: Most useful in spring, when it rains a lot. Getting wet makes you cold and lowers sanity.

notes.name: Sewing Kit
notes.does: Repairs worn clothing.
notes.bestFor: Cheaper than remaking winter clothing. Keep one for the cold season.

notes.name: Tooth Trap
notes.does: A reusable trap on the ground that hurts anything that walks over it.
notes.bestFor: Place a field of them near your camp and lead hounds through it.

notes.name: Piggyback
notes.does: A larger backpack that slows you down a little.
notes.bestFor: Worth it when you need to carry a lot, such as when moving your camp.

notes.name: Walking Cane
notes.does: Makes you walk faster while you hold it.
notes.bestFor: A big help for exploring. It needs a rare item dropped by a hunter who only appears in winter, so it comes late.

notes.name: Ice
notes.does: Mined from glaciers in winter. It melts over time.
notes.bestFor: A handy filler ingredient for cooking, and it cools you down in summer.

notes.name: Marble
notes.does: A heavy stone mined from statues and pillars.
notes.bestFor: Not needed early. It is used for strong but slow armour.

notes.name: Living Log
notes.does: A magic log dropped by tree guards.
notes.bestFor: Only needed for magic items. Ignore it in your first weeks.

notes.name: Electrical Doodad
notes.does: A refined part made from Gold and stone.
notes.bestFor: Needed for the Alchemy Engine and the Lightning Rod.

notes.name: Light Bulb
notes.does: A glowing plant picked in caves.
notes.bestFor: Fuel for the Lantern. It also restores a little health when eaten.

notes.name: Fireflies
notes.does: Glowing insects you can catch with a Bug Net at dusk and night.
notes.bestFor: Needed for the Miner Hat.

notes.name: Butterfly Wings
notes.does: Dropped by butterflies. Eating them restores a little health.
notes.bestFor: A safe, easy way to heal a little in your first days.

notes.name: Rot
notes.does: What food turns into when it spoils.
notes.bestFor: Do not throw it away. Use it as fertilizer for plants.

notes.name: Frog Legs
notes.does: Meat dropped by frogs.
notes.bestFor: Cook them for a decent meal. Fight frogs one at a time: a group is dangerous.

notes.name: Fish
notes.does: Caught at ponds with a Fishing Rod.
notes.bestFor: Cook it for a solid meal.

notes.name: Egg
notes.does: Laid by a bird you keep in a Birdcage.
notes.bestFor: A useful cooking ingredient once you have a Birdcage.

notes.name: Drumstick
notes.does: Meat dropped by Gobblers, the turkeys that hide in berry bushes.
notes.bestFor: Cook it for a quick meal. Gobblers eat your berries, so they are worth hunting.

notes.name: Fire Pit
notes.does: A permanent fire. It gives light and warmth, lets you cook, and never disappears: add fuel to light it again.
notes.bestFor: Build one at your camp as soon as you settle. Unlike a Campfire, it does not set nearby things on fire.

notes.name: Crock Pot
notes.does: A cooking station that turns four ingredients into one much better meal.
notes.bestFor: The biggest step up for your food. Build it as soon as you have Charcoal and Cut Stone.

notes.name: Cut Stone
notes.does: A refined material made from Rocks.
notes.bestFor: Needed for the Crock Pot, the Alchemy Engine and stone buildings. Turn spare Rocks into Cut Stone at camp.

notes.name: Straw Roll
notes.does: A bedroll you can use once to sleep through the night. Sleeping restores sanity but costs hunger.
notes.bestFor: A cheap way to recover sanity early, before you can build a Tent. Eat before you sleep.

notes.name: Fur Roll
notes.does: A warmer bedroll that can be used several times.
notes.bestFor: Worth making once you can get Bunny Puffs. It also restores some health while you sleep.

notes.name: Luxury Axe
notes.does: A golden Axe that lasts much longer than the normal one.
notes.bestFor: Make it once you have spare Gold. It saves the Flint that normal tools keep using up.

notes.name: Opulent Pickaxe
notes.does: A golden Pickaxe that lasts much longer than the normal one.
notes.bestFor: Worth it if Gold is easier for you to find than Flint.

notes.name: Regal Shovel
notes.does: A golden Shovel that lasts much longer than the normal one.
notes.bestFor: Useful when you move many plants to your camp.

notes.name: Wood Wall
notes.does: A wall section made from wood. It burns.
notes.bestFor: Cheap fencing for animals. Keep it away from fire, and use stone if you need real protection.

notes.name: Stone Wall
notes.does: A strong wall section made from Cut Stone. It does not burn.
notes.bestFor: Use it to protect your camp or to build a pen.

notes.name: Sign
notes.does: A sign you can place in the world.
notes.bestFor: Mark important spots, such as the road back to your camp.

notes.name: Meat Effigy
notes.does: Brings you back to life at its location if you die.
notes.bestFor: Insurance for dangerous plans. Building it costs some of your maximum health while it stands.

notes.name: Endothermic Fire Pit
notes.does: A permanent fire that gives light but cools you down.
notes.bestFor: Build it before summer, when a normal fire would make overheating worse.

notes.name: Hound's Tooth
notes.does: Dropped by hounds.
notes.bestFor: Save them for Tooth Traps and the Sewing Kit.
